original_title: Bruce Springsteen and the E Street Band: Land of Hope and Dreams American Tour (Philadelphia Freedom Cut): Part Four
overview: Bruce Springsteen and The E Street Band have shared the fourth and final installment of “Land of Hope and Dreams American Tour: Philadelphia Freedom Cut,” featuring official video of the full encore from that May 30 show. Kicking off with “American Land” and building to signature live staples “Born to Run,” “Dancing In The Dark” and “Tenth Avenue Freeze-Out,” the performance concludes with The E Street Band version of Bob Dylan’s classic “Chimes Of Freedom.”
